html:
Ukaribu wa Mapenzi Uliozingatia Kristo ni mfululizo wa mafundisho juu ya ukaribu wa biblía uliofundishwa na Paul Hershberger. Alifundisha mafundisho haya mara kadhaa katika maeneo tofauti kwa kipindi cha miaka kumi iliyopita. Hivi karibuni, tuliyarekodi na kuyafupisha kwa ajili ya msomaji. Baada ya kuchapisha makala hizi sita zote katika The Heartbeat of the Remnant, tutazichapisha kwenye brosha. Hii ni makala ya kwanza kati ya sita.

Utangulizi

Mimi na mke wangu tulipata neema ya kuwa na ukaribu wa mapenzi bila majuto au hatia. Tulibarikiwa na wazazi waliotuelekeza kwa njia nzuri na kutupa fursa ambazo wao hawakuwa nazo.

Kama huna ushuhuda huo au kumbukumbu hiyo, tafadhali usijaze kwa majuto. Lakini sala yangu kwako ni kwamba upate mzigo wa moyoni na kuona wazi kabisa kuwa unataka hilo kwa watoto wako. Hilo linaweza kuwa zawadi yako.

Ukaribu wa mapenzi uliozingatia Kristo ni kipindi kati ya maisha ya mtu asiye ameolewa/ameoa na maisha ya ndoa. Maamuzi unayofanya katika kipindi hiki yataathiri maisha yako yote baadaye. Kwa baraka za Mungu kwa maisha yako, unaweza kumaliza bila majuto wala hatia.

Matarajio matano kwa mfululizo huu wa Ukaribu wa Mapenzi Uliozingatia Kristo.

Lengo #1. Kurudisha mioyo ya baba kwa watoto wao.

Lengo #2. Kurudisha mioyo ya watoto kwa baba zao.

Lengo #3. Ili wazazi wapate mzigo wa kuongoza kila mmoja wa watoto wao katika mapenzi kamili ya Mungu kwa maisha yao.

Lengo #4. Ili vijana wapate mzigo wa kumtafuta Mungu, kupata kuridhika na kusudi kwa kutembea na Mungu, na mtafute kukomaa katika adabu na tabia zenu.

Lengo #5. Ili wavulana na wasichana waike na kuinuka kuwa baba wema na mama wema wenye maono ya kuinua kizazi kingine kitakatifu, na Injili ya Yesu Kristo iendelee.

Mpango wa Mungu kwa Mwanamume na Mwanamke

Mhubiri 12:1 inasema, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.” Moyo wangu ni kwamba kila mmoja wenu, mkumbuke Muumba wenu katika siku za ujana wenu. Geuza moyo wako, mwelekeo wako, na maisha yako kumtafuta Muumba wako, Mungu Mwenyezi, mbinguni.

Anamaanisha nini, “while the evil days come not” na “the years draw nigh”? Inamaanisha kumtafuta Bwana unapokuwa mchanga. Tumia nguvu za ujana wako kumtafuta Mungu. Vijana, ninyi ni wachanga na mmejaa mawazo, maono, mipango, na ndoto. Nadhani hakuna mmoja wenu anayependa kukaa tu kwenye kiti cha urahisi, kuweka miguu juu, na kuota tu jinsi maisha yatakavyokuwa mabaya na ya kutisha. Hatufanyi hivyo, sivyo? Lakini kama hatutatembea na Mungu na kufuata mpango wa Mungu, mambo magumu yatajipata. Wakati mambo magumu yanapoingia maisha, hatuna pa kugeukia. Tunaota maisha yatatoka vizuri. Maamuzi na vitendo vya ujana wetu vinatuathiri kwa maisha yote. Habari njema ni kwamba vinaweza kuathiri kwa njia njema. Habari mbaya ni kwamba vinaweza kuathiri kwa njia mbaya. Inategemea maamuzi na chaguo tunayofanya. Lakini vijana, ninyi mna fursa ya kuchagua.

Twendeni mwanzoni mwa Mwanzo.

“And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).

“And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:26-28).

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him” (Genesis 2:18). “I’ll make him an help that is meet for him.” Mungu alisema Atafanya hivyo.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them” (Genesis 1:27). Mungu aliumba. Mungu alituumba sisi wa kiume na wa kike. Inahitaji imani nyingi kupuuza kumwamini mtu anayesema tumekua kikamilifu kuwa wa kiume na wa kike. Uumbaji wa kiume na kike ni mpango wa Mungu. Ni moja ya ushahidi wa kuishi wa Uumbaji. Mungu aliumba. Mungu ndiye Mwandishi wa mpango. Na mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

Ningependa kuangalia vipengele kumi tofauti vya baraka za mpango wa Mungu.

1) Mungu amemleta Hawa kwa Adamu.

“And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man” (Genesis 2:22-23).

Mungu alifanya Adamu alale usingizi mzito. Kisha Mungu akamuumba Hawa na kumleta kwa Adamu. Adamu aliamka na kutambua, “Huyu ni wangu!” Alikuwa ameona wanyama wote wakipita alipowapa majina. Sasa Mungu anamletea mtu aliyemfanyia yeye. Pia alitambua, “Alitolewa upande wangu.” Yuko karibu na moyo wake. “Huyu ni mfupa wa mifupa yangu na nyama ya nyama yangu.” Sio mbwa; si twiga, wala nyani, wala sura. Huyu Mungu alimletea ni kama yeye. Mpango wa Mungu una baraka.

Adamu na Hawa hawakuwahi kuwa na mwenzake kabla. Adamu na Hawa hawakuwahi kutoa hisia za moyo wao kwa mtu mwingine. Kitu kilitokea ndani ya mioyo ya Adamu na Hawa. Adamu alikuwa “mwanaume wa mwanamke mmoja,” na Hawa alikuwa “mwanamke wa mwanaume mmoja.” Hawakuwahi kumpa mapenzi yao mtu mwingine. Mungu pia ana mpango huo kwetu. Mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

2) Kuwaacha na kushikana kwa umoja kwa maisha.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

Aya hii inasema, “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother,” lakini Adamu na Hawa hawakuwa na baba wala mama. Mungu anamaanisha haitafanya kazi kuwepo kwa kushikana bila kuwa na kuacha. Pia, katika Marko 10:7, tunasoma, “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife.” Huu ni mpango wa Mungu, na mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

Kuacha inamaanisha kuacha nyuma, kukataliwa. “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother” ni kuacha wazazi nyuma. Fikiria kijana ambaye ana maisha ya nyumbani mazuri sana. Amebarikiwa na ana kila anachohitaji. Hata hivyo mara Mungu anapomletea Hawa kwake, kitu kinaamka ndani yake, na anasema, “Ninaacha!” Lakini huu ni mpango wa Mungu. Na mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

Sio tu kuacha baba na mama; pia anashikana na mke wake. Kushikana kunamaanisha “kukamatika, kushikamana.” Sisi tunafahamu sana paneli za mbao zilizoshikamana kwa gundi. Aina mbalimbali za samani thabiti zinatengenezwa kwa paneli zilizogandishwa. Na ikiwa zimengandishwa vizuri, hazitatengana kwa nyufa. Ukizitenganisha, utalazimika kuvunja mbao. Gundi ya Mungu ni sawa, inaposhikilia watu wawili pamoja. Njia pekee ya kuwatenganisha ni kwa kuvunja na kuparadza na Mungu hafurahii hivyo. Lakini kuacha na kushikana, kubaki pamoja na kushikamana, huo ni mpango wa Mungu na unaleta baraka.

3) Watakuwa mwili mmoja.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). Watu wawili wasio wa ndoa watakapokuwa wanandoa, wanakuwa chombo kimoja mbele za Mungu, na wanakuwa familia moja mbele za Mungu. Wanakuwa mwili mmoja, ambapo Mungu anawaona wakiwa pamoja kama mmoja.

“And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder” (Mark 10:8-9). Mpango wa Mungu kwa kiume na kike ni kwamba Anakuletea Hawa kwa Adamu. Kisha kuacha na kushikana kutatungia. Anawafanya wawe mwili mmoja. Kutengana hakuleti baraka bali huleta mateso, maumivu, taabu, na majeraha. Hakuna baraka katika kutengana. Lakini mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

4) Si mzigo usiokuwa sawa.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness” (2 Corinthians 6:14-15). “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord” (1 Corinthians 7:39).

Mpango wa Mungu ni kwamba ndoa iwe mzigo sawa. Mungu hatamletea Hawa kwa Adamu katika ndoa ambayo ni mzigo usio sawa. Tufikirie juu ya kuacha na kushikana, kushikamana, na kuwa wawili wakawa mmoja. Katika ndoa, wawili hao sasa ni mmoja mbele za Mungu. Fikiria kuwa katika mahusiano mabaya ya ndoa kama haya—familia kama hii ikijaribu kufanya kazi pamoja. Hakutakuwa na baraka yoyote.

Lakini mzigo sawa unaleta baraka! Mungu anataka tufawe pamoja kwa mwili mmoja, moyo mmoja, na akili moja. Anataka tuungane kwa moyo, akili, na mwili—kiwanja chote, kuwa pamoja. Mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

5) Mungu alipanga tupate watoto.

“And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:28). Fikiria furaha na muujiza kila mara mtoto anapozaliwa kwenye nyumba ya Kikristo. Mungu alipanga hivyo. Na kama Mungu alimletea Adamu Hawa yake, na wakamuacha na kushikana, wakawa mwili mmoja, moyo mmoja, akili moja. Kama wameungana kwa upatanisho na Mungu awebariki nao kwa watoto, kuwa ni pahali pa furaha ambapo Mungu anaweza kuishi. “And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth” (Genesis 9:1). “And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein” (Genesis 9:7). Mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

6) Mpangilio wa uongozi.

“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God” (1 Corinthians 11:3). Ni Mungu, kisha Kristo, kisha mwanaume, na mwanamke. Mungu aliweka mpangilio wa uongozi, na mpangilio huu wa uongozi ni baraka. Ni mpango wa Mungu, na ni baraka.

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth” (Ephesians 6:1-3). . Watoto, mwatii wazazi wenu ndani ya Bwana ni sehemu ya mpangilio wa uongozi. Hii si vigumu kuelewa, sivyo? Nyumba inayofuata mpango wa Mungu ni hali yenye baraka. Vijana jifunze kuwa chini ya mamlaka. Fanya hilo kuwa kipaumbele chako kikuu. Mara tu unapojifunza kuwa chini ya mamlaka, ndivyo utakuwa umeandaliwa vizuri kwa wajibu wa maisha.

Ninakumbuka nilitazama maisha ya ndoa na kuwa na matarajio ya kufundisha watoto na kumlea familia ya kimungu. Nilisikiliza mfululizo wa “Nyumba ya Kimungu” na nadhani nilikuwa tayari. Lakini kisha siku ilikuja ilipo kuwa zangu nafasi na wajibu, ghafla, moyo wangu ulitaka kukauka. Wajibu hauioni kama ndoto. WEWE unahitaji kufanya kitu! WEWE ndio mwenye jukumu. WEWE unahitaji kufanya iwezekane. Na, kwa njia, sio tu kuifanyia iwezekane; unahitaji kufanya iwezekane kwa njia ya Kikristo. Unahitaji kuifanya kwa njia ambayo unyenyekevu wa Roho wa Mungu unaweza kushuka juu ya familia yako. Kadri tunavyojifunza jinsi ya kuwa chini ya mamlaka, ndivyo tutakavyokuwa tayari zaidi kwa yale wajibu. Kadri tunavyoelewa tunamhitaji Mungu, ndivyo tutaendelea vizuri. Tufanye kuwa kipaumbele kujifunza kuwa chini ya mamlaka kama watoto na vijana. “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee” (Proverbs 3:1-2).

Mungu ataongeza baraka zake ikiwa tutabaki katika mpangilio huu wa uongozi. Kadri unavyojifunza jinsi ya kuwa chini ya mamlaka, ndivyo utakavyoibarikiwa unapopanga nyumba yako. Mpango wa Mungu una baraka.

7) Ndoa ya kimungu.

Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

Kwanza angalia aya ya 21, “submitting yourselves one to another.” Kuna mchanganyiko unaohitajika ndani ya nyumba ya kimungu. Mchanganyiko huu unapaswa kutokea kwa woga wa Mungu. Ikiwa tunajisalimisha mmoja kwa mwingine kwa woga wa Mungu, tutamtii Mungu kwa sababu tunataka baraka zake.

Ephesians 5: 22, 24 “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.” Wasichana wadogo, mnaweza kuhesabu hilo: kumtumikia Baba ni sawa na kumtii mume. Unaweza kutekeleza mazoezi ukiwa binginine. Hii itasaidia kujenga tabia katika maisha yako. Kuwa mwanamke mwasiye tumia na mwenye madoa hayataleta baraka ya Mungu.

Inaendelea na kusema, katika Ephesians 5:25,28,29. “Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it . . . So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.” Vijana wa kiume, aya hii inasema kwamba waume wanapaswa kuwapenda wake zao. Hivyo nani unafikiri Mungu aliwapa katika maisha yako kukutayarisha kupenda mke wako? Mama yako! Unataka kujifunza kupenda mke wako? Jifunze jinsi ya kuishi vizuri na mama yako, mpendeni mama yako, na mruhusu kujali. Unataka kufanya mazoezi ya kupenda mke wako wa baadaye? Nenda, mpendeni mama yako.

Aya 33, “Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” Mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

8) Kuwa warithi pamoja wa neema ya uzima.

1 Peter 3:7 “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” Kama waume, tunamzawadia heshima mke. Yeye ni mfuko dhaifu na ndiye aliyebeba watoto! Amepitia mabadiliko mengi ya kiuchungu maishani mwake. Yeye ndiye anayechoka mapema na kuchoka zaidi.

Na anasema, “Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.”

Vijana wa kiume, jifunze kuelewa mama yako na dada zako. Itakusaidia baada ya kuolewa. Usihitimishe kwa kusema—ah, hao ni wanawake tu. Hapana, unataka baraka za Mungu. Jifunze kuwajua na kuwaelewa.

“Being heirs together of the grace of life.” Mungu anataka tuwe warithi pamoja wa neema ya uzima. Kama hatuwezi kuwa warithi pamoja wa neema ya uzima, je, tunaweza kuwa warithi waliotengana wa neema ya uzima? Sidhani hivyo. Anasema tunapaswa kuwa warithi pamoja ili sala zetu zisizuilikwe. Hivyo kama tuko warithi waliotengana, tunaweza kusema sala zetu zitakuwa zimeingiliwa? Ndiyo, sala zetu zitaingiliwa. Tumpa heshima mke kama mfuko dhaifu. Kila ungozi utakaoweza kupata katika eneo hili utakuibarikia baadaye. Inafaa. Mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

9) Nyumba yenye baraka na usalama.

Hii inatokana sehemu na 1 Peter 3:7, lakini pia kutoka Zaburi 144:12 “That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace.” Neema ya Mungu iko juu ya nyumba salama ambapo kuna umoja. Pale Baba anapomfahamu Mama, pale Baba anakujali Mama. Baba anahudumia na kuwa pale kusaidia na kuelekeza. Yuko pale kutoa mwelekeo kwa moyo wa huruma. Mpango wa Mungu kwa kiume na kike—mpango wa Mungu unaleta baraka.

10) Kama Kristo na kanisa.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church” (Ephesians 5:24-29).

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it.” Mungu anatafuta wanaume walio tayari kutoa maisha yao. Vijana wa kiume wasiooa, ambao wako tayari kujibu wito na kutoa maisha yao. Huu ni wito wa juu wa Mungu. Ni mpango wa Mungu.

Vijana wa kiume, mko tayari kuachana na maisha yenu, ajenda zenu, na yale mambo ya kujitegemea mnayopenda kufanya? Mko tayari kuwa na subira, mpole, na mwenye kuelewa? Mko tayari kupoteza usingizi na kuendelea hata unapokuwa mchovu? Mko tayari kubaki mtulivu na kutochochea majibu katika hali za mteguko? Mko tayari kuongoza na kuelekeza mke na watoto, nafsi za milele, kupitia maisha haya?

Lakini ombi langu ni kwamba mwajitolee na useme, “Niko tayari kujitolea kwa Neno la Mungu, mapenzi ya Mungu, mpango wa Mungu, na nitatoa maisha yangu. Niko tayari kuyatoa mezani.” Yesu alitoa maisha Yake kwa ajili yetu, na Anakilinganisha ndoa na kanisa na Yeye.

Pia kunahitaji wake ambao ni wanyenyekevu na walio tayari kuabidiana kwa mamlaka. Wake ambao hawafuati falsafa za wanawake za nyakati zetu bali wamefurahia kuwa watunza nyumbani.

Wasichana wadogo, mko tayari kujiunga? Mtoe moyo wako ili uongozwe na kuongozwa? Mko tayari kumfuata na kukubali kwa furaha mamlaka yako? Mko tayari kutumika na kutoa nguvu zako kwa ajili ya familia yako? Mko tayari kutumika na kutoa kwa ajili ya FAMILIA YAKO? Ukiolewa siku moja, itakuwa FAMILIA YAKO ambayo utatumika kwake na kutoa. Mko tayari kuvumilia maumivu na kutokuwa na raha? Mko tayari kuwa msaidizi, ukijitoa kwa ajili ya mzigo na maono yake?

Lakini tunapotazama mpango na baraka za Mungu, unataka baraka za Mungu, vijana! Lakini hilo linamaanisha unahitaji kufanya maamuzi yanayofaa. Inuka na fanya maamuzi yatakayoleta ukomavu. Ukomavu huja kwa mchakato wa kumtafuta Mungu. Fanya dhamira moyoni mwako kufunguka kwa baraka na kanuni za Mungu. Nakuhimiza utembee na Mungu, uwe na uhusiano na Yesu Kristo, na ufanye hivyo kwa unyenyekevu.

Tafuta tabia inayofanana na ya Kristo, na fanya kwa makusudi. Ni rahisi sana tuishi maisha jinsi yanavyotokea. Lakini tukifanya maamuzi kwa makusudi, yatatupeleka mahali! Maamuzi hayo ni muhimu. Fanya vitu kulingana na mpango wa Mungu.

Mungu ana mpango kwa kiume na kike na ana mpango kwa ajili yako.

title: Ukaribu wa Mapenzi Uliozingatia Kristo
